action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thri-kreen makes two attacks, using Gythka or Chatkcha in any combination.

action.name: Gythka
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) Slashing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Leap
entries: The thri-kreen jumps up to 15 feet by spending 5 feet of movement.
Thri-kreen marauders employ weapons made of stone and bone, such as the spear-like gythka and throwing blades called chatkcha.
